lines.latin: Ad régias Agni dapes, stolis amícti cándidis,
lines.english: At the royal banquet of the Lamb, clothed in white robes,

lines.latin: post tránsitum maris Rubri, Christo canámus Príncipi:
lines.english: the Red Sea crossed, let us sing to Christ our Prince:

lines.latin: Divína cujus cáritas sacrum propínat sánguinem,
lines.english: whose divine charity gives us His sacred Blood to drink,

lines.latin: almíque membra córporis amor sacérdos ímmolat.
lines.english: and Love, the priest, offers in sacrifice the members of His holy Body.

lines.latin: Sparsum cruórem póstibus vastátor horret Angelus:
lines.english: The destroying Angel shrinks from the blood sprinkled on the doorposts:

lines.latin: fugítque divísum mare; mergúntur hostes flúctibus.
lines.english: the sea parts and flees; the enemies are drowned in the waves.

lines.latin: Jam Pascha nostrum Christus est, Paschális idem víctima,
lines.english: Now Christ is our Pasch, and He the Paschal victim,

lines.latin: et pura puris méntibus sinceritátis ázyma.
lines.english: and the pure unleavened bread of sincerity for pure minds.

lines.latin: O vera cæli víctima, subjécta cui sunt tártara,
lines.english: O true Victim from heaven, to whom hell is made subject,

lines.latin: solúta mortis víncula, recépta vitæ prǽmia.
lines.english: the bonds of death are loosed, the rewards of life won back.

lines.latin: Victor subáctis ínferis tropǽa Christus éxplicat,
lines.english: Christ the victor, hell overthrown, displays His trophies,

lines.latin: cælóque apérto, súbditum regem tenebrárum trahit.
lines.english: and, heaven opened, drags the king of darkness captive.

lines.latin: Ut sis perénne méntibus paschále, Jesu, gáudium,
lines.english: That Thou mayest be, O Jesus, an everlasting Paschal joy to our minds,

lines.latin: a morte dira críminum vitæ renátos líbera.
lines.english: free those reborn to life from the dread death of sin.

lines.latin: Deo Patri sit glória, et Fílio, qui a mórtuis
lines.english: To God the Father be glory, and to the Son, who from the dead

lines.latin: surréxit, ac Paráclito, in sempitérna sǽcula.
lines.english: is risen, and to the Paraclete, for everlasting ages.
